source.title: 2026 NFL fantasy football: Breakout candidates at QB, RB, WR and TE
source.author: Matt Okada
source.summary: Uses Next Gen Stats, role changes, and ESPN ADP to identify 14 breakout candidates in PPR formats.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Dart already produced QB4-level scoring in his starts and regains key weapons behind an improved line.
takeaways.rationale: Dart already produced QB4-level scoring in his starts and regains key weapons behind an improved line.
risks: Concussion exposure and continued development as a passer.
assumptions: Malik Nabers and Cam Skattebo return effectively.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Ward improved markedly after the 2025 bye and now has a much stronger receiver group.
takeaways.rationale: Ward improved markedly after the 2025 bye and now has a much stronger receiver group.
risks: The offense still depends on a substantial second-year leap.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Skattebo produced like an elite back when healthy and now runs behind an improved, Harbaugh-shaped offense.
takeaways.rationale: Skattebo produced like an elite back when healthy and now runs behind an improved, Harbaugh-shaped offense.

takeaways.label: breakout
